from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UndistributedProfitEntry(BaseModel):
    """One company's undistributed profit (未分配利润) value from their financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code of the company")
    undistributed_profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The end-period balance of '未分配利润' as a signed number")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")
    is_end_period: bool | None = Field(description="True if this amount is end-period balance, False if beginning balance")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text showing the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    undistributed_profit_entries: list[UndistributedProfitEntry]
